name: Rakshasa
description: Demons who took over the old Sultai and were manipulative allies, now shunned.

description_citations.text: "Sultai Brood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tasigur offends the rakshasa and makes a pact with Silumgar, who inherits their pacts.
timeline.quote: Tasigur made a pact with Silumgar

citation.text: "Demon", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakshasa and naga manipulate Tasigur into offending them, causing their defection.
timeline.quote: Tasigur was manipulated by the rakshasa and naga into a series of events that eventually led him to offend them, causing their defection.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi explains she has raised an army by levying five percent of each province, then demanding the eldest born, with Rakshasa enforcing compliance.
timeline.quote: she had requested that all of the Sultai provinces provide five percent of their population to be enlisted into Sidisi's army.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
timeline.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: After Tasigur offends the Rakshasa and Nagas, the Sultai make a pact with Silumgar.
timeline.quote: forcing them thus to make a pact with Silumgar and his brood

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Sultai reject the old cruelty and seek a new cultural identity through the counsel of ancient zombies.
timeline.quote: They found this in the counsel of the ancient zombies raised during the rebellion, who spoke of a time before the pacts with the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: who have made allegiances with Rakshasa to gain incredible necromancy powers

citation.text: "Naga", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Powerful demons whose age-old deals are the source of much Sultai power and undead.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

pages_say.description: Sultai emissaries who wield magic and enforce Sidisi's army levy in noncompliant provinces.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

pages_say.description: Demons with whom Sultai rulers made pacts to secure their elite status.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

pages_say.description: Demons who with the naga allow humans to rule the Sultai.
